item.title: 19 days in jail, 'stole' police chair and deportation: Japanese student’s Bengaluru story
item.summary: A Japanese student recently secured compensation after spending nineteen unjust days in custody. In a bizarre twist, he tried to evade repatriation by pilfering a police chair, aiming to extend his time in India. This incident arose from conflicts at an English academy and alleged bribery claims. The human rights commission ruled in his favor, underscoring the complexities of his legal and immigration battles in Bengaluru.
